title: Lost acknowledgements and a restart (with GS.04b current-index consumer cut)
story: 1% of commits lose their ACK and are retried; mid-run, the engine (or QLever broker) is killed and restarted. Added schedule GS.04b: the current index's feed consumer is cut for 60 s while the source keeps committing.
checked: Every retry returns the original receipt; no acknowledged commit is lost; readers resume at their pinned bases. GS.04b: reads at bases beyond the index watermark wait or route to a fallback per TARGETS 4.1; none answers from the stale index.
rungNote: Sized for a shared 2-CPU dev slot (measured 2026-11-07: about 0.1 to 1 commits/s under pinned readers): the rung is the 10k-subject background world; the live phase runs the fixed trace (15 facts/s, open loop) for 25 s with a scaled scenario overlay. Year-one volumes wait for PLAN section 8 order 6. The lost-ACK rate is raised to 20% at 10k so about 6 losses happen in one run; the trace keeps its own 1%.

witnesses.positive: active subjects (two commands each, some with lost ACKs, some in flight at the restart)

subSchedules.restart: Triplex runtime restart (client/broker side) on every slot; in-flight commands resolve by commandId
subSchedules.engine-kill: engine container kill and restart: only on an exclusive slot with --faults engine
subSchedules.04b: current-index consumer cut for 60 s: only on compositions with a separate current index (EXP-X04/EXP-Q05)

faults: lost ACK (client discards the receipt and retries)
GS.04b consumer cut (separate current index only)
